fields.value: Retest Corp 19Nov: -1 Retribution, +1 Anoetic Void from Tags & consequences. Hypothesis: paid remote defense can protect one scoring window.
Give up tag-conditional program/hardware trash and 3 additional influence. Reserve 2 credits plus 2 expendable HQ cards; legality does not prove support.
Income before exposure; protect scoring remote and R&D; reassess ice against visible breakers and Tao swaps. Watch Conduit.

One full Corp game vs Tao: Corp 9–2, UI turn16. Anoetic drawn turn7, installed scoring Remote2, rezzed and activated turn14 after White/Tithe/Funhouse passed. Paid2 and trashed Funhouse + Hansei Review; ended run protecting Send a Message. Whitespace stopped earlier run before Void could trigger. Remaining Retribution used after Public Trail to trash Cleaver.

Keep as learning revision for now. Repeat only to observe multiple Void windows and draw/support costs; win alone does not compare baseline. Reassess Tao ice swaps, build reserve before advancing 5-cost agendas.
